title: Building an AI Testing Strategy
description: Title slide for Lecture 10 of the AI Testing Academy series.

title: Learning Objectives
description: What students will be able to do by the end of the lecture.

title: What We Have Built So Far
description: Recap of Lectures 1–9 and the gap that a deliberate strategy fills.

title: Common Pitfalls
description: Six pitfalls teams fall into without a deliberate AI testing strategy.

title: What a Strategy Covers
description: Five pillars of an AI testing strategy: coverage, layers, metrics, reporting, and people.

title: Section 1 — Strategy Layers
description: Dark navy section divider introducing Section 1.

title: Four Test Layers
description: The adapted AI test pyramid: unit, integration, system, and production monitoring.

title: Unit Testing AI Features
description: Layer 1: unit tests for deterministic AI components — no live model calls.

title: Integration Tests
description: Layer 2: integration tests on a golden set, running per PR with LLM-as-judge.

title: System Tests (Nightly)
description: Layer 3: nightly full eval suite with security scans and cost/latency benchmarks.

title: Production Monitoring
description: Layer 4: shadow evals on live traffic samples for drift and cost detection.

title: Worked Example: Querying the Quality Scorecard
description: Supabase worked example: querying the ai_quality_scorecard table for strategy dashboard.

title: Worked Example: Golden-Set Eval Runs in Supabase
description: Supabase worked example: storing integration eval runs and querying rolling mean score to gate PR merges.

title: Section 2 — Metrics That Matter
description: Dark navy section divider introducing Section 2.

title: Accuracy and Quality Metrics
description: LLM-judge pass rate, golden-set mean score, hallucination rate, and refusal rate.

title: Cost Metrics
description: Cost per 1k tokens, cost per invocation, and monthly projected spend vs. budget.

title: Latency Metrics
description: p50/p95/p99 latency targets and time-to-first-token (TTFT) with scoring formula.

title: Security Posture
description: Prompt injection resistance, PII leak rate, harmful content block rate — all hard gates.

title: The Quality Scorecard
description: Sample scorecard table combining accuracy, cost, latency, and security per release.

title: Worked Example: Maturity Self-Assessment Trend
description: Supabase worked example: storing quarterly maturity assessments and querying 4-quarter trend.

title: Worked Example: Inserting a Scorecard Row
description: Supabase worked example: inserting a full quality scorecard row after nightly tests and querying the release trend.

title: Section 3 — Reporting and Continuous Improvement
description: Dark navy section divider introducing Section 3.

title: Stakeholder Dashboards
description: Executive, engineering, and security dashboard views with refresh cadence.

title: The Retro Cadence
description: Sprint, monthly, and quarterly retro meetings covering the full improvement loop.

title: Worked Example: Eval-Set Audit Trail
description: Supabase worked example: logging eval-set update events for an audit trail.

title: Tracking Model Changes
description: Daily fingerprint probes, canary eval on hash change, and regression pinning policy.

title: Worked Example: Team-Wide Rollout Report
description: Supabase worked example: querying rollout progress to find teams missing integration tests.

title: Worked Example: Production Drift Alerts
description: Supabase worked example: inserting drift alerts from shadow evals, querying open incidents, and closing resolved alerts.
